messages:
cameron: saw a PR titled `fix: semver therapy` and had to open it
nira: please tell me it includes a haiku about commas
pat: it does. excerpt: "semicolon ghosts roam / missing commas find their way / linter lights the dawn"
build-bot: Build passed at 08:45 — note: version field `version: 2.0.0..beta` triggers a soft-warning (reaction: :warning:)
cameron: double-dot beta. the ultimate emotional punctuation
nira: I'm making a votable sticky: 'Ban double dots, adopt haiku for commit messages'
pat: proposal: whenever someone pushes a non-semver tag, they must also submit a 3-line compiler haiku
cameron: examples: "tabs vs spaces / the feud ages like fine code / indent heals with time" :laughing:
build-bot: FYI: auto-lint will replace `2.0.0..beta` with `2.0.0-beta` unless author adds a haiku in PR body
nira: wait, the linter is blackmailing us into poetry? I love this company
pat: new team tradition: Friday morning 'Compiler Complaints & Coffee' — bring grievances and pastries
cameron: who brings the erasers for stray trailing whitespace? @pat
pat: I volunteer my soul and a pack of erasers
nira: closing this thread: PR opened `chore(lint): enforce semver, accept haikus as exception` — commit message will be a haiku
